Great questions! Here are some thoughts.

1. For one, my dataset size is quite small here, so 1500 embedding dims would cause some issues with KMeans. Here I experimented with a few different choices, but the intuition I used was since dream outcomes will contain more information than job titles, more dimensions will be required for it.

2. One thing you could try is fine-tuning the embeddings on positive/negative pairs. This will hopefully result in a model better tailored for your use case. I talk more about that here: https://youtu.be/hOLBrIjRAj4
